defensiveAbilities.name: Antigrav Interference
defensiveAbilities.description: 120 feet. The void palm causes antigravitational technology to malfunction. Upon entering this aura, any items or objects with the tech trait that employ some form of antigrav tech, including antigrav harnesses as well as most hover vehicles and starships, become glitching 1.

defensiveAbilities.name: Disorienting Patterns
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature with darkvision within 60 feet of the void palm begins its turn

Requirements The void palm is in darkness

Effect The patterns on a void palm's mottled red fronds resemble a distant star field when viewed in the darkness. The void palm sways its fronds in a disorienting manner. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 25 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes immune to Disorienting Patterns for 24 hours.

Success The creature is Dazzled until the end of the void palm's next turn.

Failure As success, and the creature is also Off-Guard to the void palm's melee Strikes while it's dazzled.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is also Stupefied 1 for 1 minute

offensiveAbilities.name: Double Lash
offensiveAbilities.description: The void palm makes two sweeping frond Strikes against the same target, each using its current multiple attack penalty. If both attacks hit, combine their damage. This counts as two attacks when calculating the void palm's multiple attack penalty.

offensiveAbilities.name: Gravity Void
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The void palm creates a zero-gravity area of darkness in a 20ft Type:emanation, negating the effects of gravity and non-magical light sources in the area. Magical light sources in the area work normally. The void palm is unaffected by this lack of gravity, but other creatures that enter or start their turn in the area become untethered unless they can move normally in zero-gravity environments; they're also Clumsy 1 and Off-Guard while untethered in the area. An untethered creature attempting to Push Off in the area must succeed at a DC 5 Flat or the action is disrupted. The Gravity Void lasts for 10 minutes.
